description: GCP predefined IAM roles required for CleanCloud read-only scanning
note: CleanCloud uses predefined GCP roles — no custom role needed. All roles are read-only.

roles.title: Compute Viewer
roles.justification: List and read Compute Engine resources: disks, addresses, instances, snapshots

roles.title: Cloud SQL Viewer
roles.justification: List and read Cloud SQL instances to detect idle databases

roles.title: Monitoring Viewer
roles.justification: Read Cloud Monitoring time-series metrics for Cloud SQL connection count

roles.title: Browser
roles.justification: Read project metadata (resourcemanager.projects.get) — required for --all-projects multi-project scanning

binding_scope.recommended: Organization level — grants access to all current and future projects
binding_scope.alternative: Project level — grants access to a single project only
